## Overview

Enterprise Hybrid Cloud Platform

IBM Cloud is an enterprise cloud platform for building, running, and managing applications across hybrid and multicloud environments. It combines infrastructure, platform services, AI, and automation with strong security and compliance capabilities, making it ideal for regulated industries and mission-critical workloads.

 Speed & control 

Speed with control for all apps, with built-in governance and compliance.

 Cross-management 

Manage across cloud platforms and environments as code, and at scale, for regulated industries.

 Automation 

Implement and automate continuous best practices across integration, deployment, and compliance layers.

 Cost reduction 

Reduce operational costs related to misconfigured applications.

## Features

Key capabilities

### Hybrid & Multicloud Deployment

Build, deploy, and manage applications seamlessly across on-premises infrastructure, public cloud, and multiple cloud providers. This flexibility allows teams to modernize at their own pace while avoiding vendor lock-in.

![Image 3: Hand holding a transparent digital interface with a folder icon, connected files, cloud, and document symbols](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/adobestock_585182189:4x3?dpr=on%2C1&fit=fit%2C1&wid=320&hei=240)

### Enterprise-Grade Security & Compliance

Protect sensitive data and workloads with built-in security controls, encryption, and compliance capabilities. IBM Cloud is designed to meet the strict requirements of regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, and government.

![Image 4: Hand using a mouse beside a laptop, interacting with a glowing cloud icon featuring a padlock and security symbols](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/adobestock_876865630:4x3?dpr=on%2C1&fit=fit%2C1&wid=320&hei=240)

### Scalable Infrastructure & Services

Access a wide range of compute, storage, networking, and platform services that scale automatically to match demand. This enables organizations to optimize performance, reduce costs, and support both traditional and cloud-native workloads.

![Image 5:  Isometric illustration of digital dashboards on screens connected to layered platforms and large gears, representing data systems and automation](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/adobestock_1642374755:4x3?dpr=on%2C1&fit=fit%2C1&wid=320&hei=240)

### AI & Automation Capabilities

Integrate AI, data services, and automation tools to accelerate development and improve operational efficiency. Teams can build smarter applications, streamline workflows, and gain insights from data more quickly.

![Image 6: Glowing digital brain formed by blue and pink lines hovering above a network of interconnected nodes on a dark background](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/adobestock_273431842:4x3?dpr=on%2C1&fit=fit%2C1&wid=320&hei=240)
